Profile all three uploaded raw CSV files (stores.csv, products.csv, sales_data.csv) to understand:
- Column names, data types, and nullability patterns
- Semantic meanings of each column (e.g., customer IDs, product names, dates, amounts)
- Data quality observations including cardinality, value ranges, format patterns, and anomalies
- Potential join keys and relationships across the three datasets (e.g., store_id, product_id as foreign keys)

This profile will be used to generate the Bronze STTM for intent-agnostic mechanical ingestion into the data warehouse.

Generate a complete Bronze STTM CSV that provides intent-agnostic ingestion rules for all columns from the three source CSV files (stores, products, sales_data).

For each column in each source file:
- Define the target Bronze column name (with any necessary standardization)
- Specify the target data type (string, int, float, date, boolean, etc.)
- Include type casting logic for any columns requiring conversion
- Inject metadata rows at the top of the STTM to capture load_timestamp, source file name, and run_id

The Bronze layer is a direct, mechanical mapping of every source column — no filtering, no business logic, no deduplication.
The STTM should be comprehensive and ready for Bronze table creation.
